description: Evaluation set for the Marvel/DC Fandom RAG. Every answerable question was verified to be answerable from the scraped corpus. Categories: factual (single doc), alias (retrieval by nickname), comparative (multiple relevant docs), multi_hop (several facts from one doc), unanswerable (out-of-corpus; the correct behavior is to abstain).

questions.question: What is the name of Thor's enchanted hammer?
questions.reference_answer: Thor's enchanted hammer is called Mjolnir.

questions.question: What indestructible metal is bonded to Wolverine's skeleton, and which program did it to him?
questions.reference_answer: Wolverine's skeleton is coated in Adamantium, which was done to him by the Weapon X Program.

questions.question: Who is Bruce Wayne's loyal butler?
questions.reference_answer: Bruce Wayne's loyal butler is Alfred Pennyworth.

questions.question: From which planet does Superman come?
questions.reference_answer: Superman comes from the planet Krypton; he was born Kal-El and sent to Earth as its destruction approached.

questions.question: Which African nation does Black Panther rule?
questions.reference_answer: Black Panther (T'Challa) rules the African nation of Wakanda.

questions.question: Who trained Stephen Strange in the mystic arts?
questions.reference_answer: Stephen Strange was trained in the mystic arts by the Ancient One.

questions.question: What is the source of the Flash's super-speed?
questions.reference_answer: The Flash draws his super-speed from the Speed Force.

questions.question: What island do Wonder Woman and the Amazons come from?
questions.reference_answer: Wonder Woman and the Amazons come from the island of Themyscira.

questions.question: Who runs the Suicide Squad?
questions.reference_answer: The Suicide Squad is run by Amanda Waller.

questions.question: Where did Harleen Quinzel work when she first met the Joker?
questions.reference_answer: Harleen Quinzel was working at Arkham Asylum when she met the Joker.

questions.question: Whose death taught Spider-Man about power and responsibility?
questions.reference_answer: The death of his Uncle Ben taught Peter Parker that with great power there must also come great responsibility.

questions.question: What does Ra's al Ghul use to extend his life for centuries?
questions.reference_answer: Ra's al Ghul extends his life by using Lazarus Pits.

questions.question: Which hero is known as the Man of Steel?
questions.reference_answer: Superman (Kal-El, also known as Clark Kent) is the Man of Steel.

questions.question: Who is the Dark Knight of Gotham City?
questions.reference_answer: Batman (Bruce Wayne) is the Dark Knight of Gotham City.

questions.question: Which Marvel hero holds the title of Sorcerer Supreme?
questions.reference_answer: Doctor Strange (Stephen Strange) holds the title of Sorcerer Supreme.

questions.question: Which mutant is called the Master of Magnetism?
questions.reference_answer: Magneto (Max Eisenhardt, also known as Erik Lehnsherr) is called the Master of Magnetism.

questions.question: Which villain is known as the Mad Titan?
questions.reference_answer: Thanos is known as the Mad Titan.

questions.question: Deathstroke and Deadpool are both mercenaries with similar names. What are their real names?
questions.reference_answer: Deathstroke's real name is Slade Wilson and Deadpool's real name is Wade Wilson.

questions.question: How are Superman and Supergirl related to each other?
questions.reference_answer: They are cousins: Supergirl is Kara Zor-El, the Kryptonian cousin of Superman (Kal-El).

questions.question: Hawkeye and Green Arrow are both archers. What are their civilian identities?
questions.reference_answer: Hawkeye is Clint Barton and Green Arrow is Oliver Queen.

questions.question: What is the family relationship between Thor and Loki?
questions.reference_answer: Loki is Thor's adopted brother: Odin took in Loki, so the two were raised as brothers in Asgard.

questions.question: Thanos and Darkseid are both cosmic tyrants. What does Thanos famously wield, and what world does Darkseid rule?
questions.reference_answer: Thanos famously wielded the Infinity Gauntlet, while Darkseid rules the world of Apokolips.

questions.question: What happened to Barbara Gordon after the Joker shot her, and what identity did she adopt afterwards?
questions.reference_answer: After the Joker shot her, Barbara Gordon was paralyzed and lost the use of her legs; she then became Oracle, an information broker supporting other heroes.

questions.question: How did Peter Parker get his spider powers?
questions.reference_answer: Peter Parker gained his powers after being bitten by a radioactive spider.

questions.question: How did Steve Rogers become Captain America, and who was his wartime partner?
questions.reference_answer: Steve Rogers became Captain America after being given the Super-Soldier Serum; his wartime partner was Bucky Barnes.

questions.question: Why is Daredevil blind, and which New York neighborhood does he protect?
questions.reference_answer: Matt Murdock was blinded in an accident involving radioactive material as a boy; he protects Hell's Kitchen in New York City.

questions.question: What drug gives Bane his enhanced strength?
questions.reference_answer: Bane's enhanced strength comes from the drug Venom.
